0022600180.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder host the Cleveland Cavaliers with both teams at 4-2, and the Thunder, 3-0 at home and 1-2 on the road, sit 2nd in the Northwest, half a game back, after losing their last two games. The Thunder will be without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Cavaliers, 2nd in the Central and 1 game back, have won their last game and are missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 121-113 win in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026, while no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
